scenes.caption: Fold top to middle; place baby face-up
scenes.narration_line: Make a diamond; fold top down. Baby face-up, neck above edge.
safety_points: Never use heavy or weighted wraps; keep head and face clear.

scenes.caption: Rest right arm; tuck left corner across
scenes.narration_line: Right arm by side, elbow bent; tuck left corner diagonally beneath right side and bottom.
safety_points: Right elbow slightly bent; leave left arm free until step four.

scenes.caption: Bring the bottom up; tuck it loosely
scenes.narration_line: Lift bottom corner; tuck loosely behind left shoulder.
safety_points: Leave the hips and legs space to move.

scenes.caption: Rest left arm; tuck right corner across
scenes.narration_line: Left arm beside body, elbow bent; cross right corner over it and tuck under baby's body.
safety_points: Keep the elbow slightly bent beside their body.
Secure loose cloth; keep the face clear.

scenes.caption: Check fit, back sleeping and rolling signs
scenes.narration_line: Chest expands; legs straighten and bend freely. Sleep on back; stop at rolling attempts.
safety_points: Stop swaddling at the first signs of rolling.
Never use heavy or weighted wraps.
